hero.lead: Dawn Errand is an errand / food-delivery SaaS platform covering the full chain — user ordering, merchant acceptance, rider delivery and platform operations. Built for multi-city, multi-region multi-tenant scenarios: ready to use out of the box and commercially deployable.

capabilities.title: One system for the entire chain
capabilities.desc: From ordering and dispatching to delivery and settlement, everything your platform needs is covered.

items.title: Ordering & Dispatch
items.desc: One-tap ordering; the system auto-matches riders by distance, capacity and regional rates, with manual assignment and grab-order support.

items.title: Real-time Delivery
items.desc: Step-by-step rider flow from accepting, pickup to delivery, with map navigation and proof-of-delivery.

items.title: Order Tracking
items.desc: Users see order status and rider location in real time; merchants track acceptance, preparation and delivery progress.

items.title: Financial Settlement
items.desc: Per-order rider settlement, merchant payout splitting and transparent platform commission, with withdrawal review and statement export.

items.title: Multi-role Permissions
items.desc: Isolated roles across platform, merchant, rider and user, with fine-grained Casbin RBAC covering seven roles.

items.title: Regions & Rates
items.desc: Per-region delivery fees, starting prices and commission rules, supporting independent operation across cities and regional hubs.

items.title: Merchant Management
items.desc: Merchant onboarding review, store management, menu on/off, business status switching and operating statistics.

items.title: Rider Management
items.desc: Rider onboarding review, online status, order history and delivery ratings to guarantee service quality.

items.title: Data Dashboard
items.desc: Order trends, business distribution, live order flow and to-do items — operating data at a glance.

scenarios.title: Use Cases
scenarios.desc: From small towns to county seats, from neighborhoods to business districts — Dawn Errand deploys anywhere.

items.title: Community Errands
items.desc: Proxy buying, parcel pickup, queue waiting and urgent pickups — covering daily errand needs of community residents.

items.title: Same-city Delivery
items.desc: Express delivery of documents, keys, credentials and other urgent items, with fixed pickup, visible progress and controlled timing.

items.title: Food Delivery
items.desc: Merchants open online stores and riders pick up and deliver — building an online food-delivery business for township restaurants.

features.title: Key Features
features.desc: Built around five chains: ordering, dispatching, delivery tracking, financial settlement and multi-role permissions.

items.title: One-tap Ordering
items.desc: Fill in pickup and drop-off details and place an order — a unified, lightweight entry for errand and food-delivery scenarios.

items.title: Smart Dispatching
items.desc: Auto-match by distance and capacity, with rider grab-order and manual dispatch for flexible scheduling.

items.title: Delivery Tracking
items.desc: Order status fully traceable; users, merchants and riders stay in sync on delivery progress.

items.title: Financial Settlement
items.desc: Per-order rider settlement, merchant payout splitting, withdrawal review and statement export for a clear money trail.

items.title: Multi-role Permissions
items.desc: Seven-role RBAC with isolated data across platform, merchant, rider and user — secure and compliant.

items.title: Stability & Security
items.desc: JWT session rotation, AES-GCM encryption of sensitive data, email / SMS verification-code login — secure and auditable.

faqPreview.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPreview.desc: Common questions about onboarding, delivery, settlement and partnership.

items.a: Delivery rates and commission rules are configured per region; each regional hub sets its own rates based on local capacity and order volume. Confirm the plan with the business team before onboarding.

Submit onboarding materials in the Merchant App; once reviewed and approved, you can open your store. Qualification upload and online review are supported, and merchants manage menus and business status independently.
Riders are settled per order with income details visible in real time. The platform reconciles by settlement cycle and supports withdrawal applications and review.
The platform uses a multi-tenant architecture supporting independent operation across multiple cities and regional hubs, each with its own rates, capacity and operating strategy.

cta.title: Bring Dawn Errand to your city
